references.text: Unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil—you shall make them from fine wheat flour. This verse describes similar offering breads used in the consecration of priests.
Instructions for a grain offering with unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers spread with oil—the same type of offerings that a Nazirite was to bring.
Thank offering with unleavened cakes mixed with oil, unleavened wafers spread with oil, and cakes of fine flour mixed with oil—parallel offering regulations.
Basket of unleavened bread used in the consecration of Aaron and his sons, corresponding to the basket of unleavened bread for the Nazirite.
Grain offering and drink offering mentioned together with other sacrifices, as at the conclusion of the law of the Nazirite.
Regulations concerning grain offerings and drink offerings that are to accompany burnt offerings and peace offerings—the same combination of sacrifices.
Grain offering and drink offering as part of a festival sacrifice, showing the usual pattern of these offerings together.
